name: MonarchCurrencySelect
title: CurrencySelect
wrapsNative: MonarchCombobox (androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox with androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet) over a bundled list of active ISO 4217 codes named with java.util.Currency.getDisplayName and getSymbol
summary: A searchable picker of a currency whose value is its ISO 4217 code, with names and symbols in the person's language.
whenToUse: For the currency of an invoice, a price list, a payout or a billing profile, when the value to store is the ISO code.
whenNotToUse: For an amount use MonarchCurrencyInput; for a short fixed list of two or three currencies without search a MonarchSelect or a segmented control is enough.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCurrencySelect(selected: String?, onSelectedChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, locale: Locale? = null, currencies: List<String>? = null, priority: List<String> = emptyList(), display: MonarchCurrencySelectDisplay = MonarchCurrencySelectDisplay.Name, presentation: MonarchComboboxPresentation = MonarchComboboxPresentation.Automatic, enabled: Boolean = true, showSymbol: Boolean = true, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, clearOptionLabel: String? = null, clearIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchCurrencySelectLabels = MonarchCurrencySelectLabels())
enum class MonarchCurrencySelectDisplay { Name, Code, CodeAndName }
class MonarchCurrencySelectLabels(label: String? = null, suggested: String? = null, all: String? = null, empty: String? = null, combobox: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels())

options.name: selected
options.description: The chosen ISO 4217 code in any case, or null.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Called with the chosen upper-case code, or null when the selection is cleared.

options.name: locale
options.description: The language of the names and symbols and of the sort order. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: currencies
options.description: Limits the list to these codes, such as the currencies the payment provider supports. null lists every active currency.

options.name: priority
options.description: Codes listed first under "Suggested" while nothing is typed.

options.name: display
options.description: The label of each currency: the name ("Euro"), the code ("EUR") or both ("EUR · Euro"). With a code the name is the second line.

options.name: presentation
options.description: Menu, Sheet, or Automatic: a menu for up to eight currencies, a sheet otherwise.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the list can be opened.

options.name: showSymbol
options.description: Shows the symbol next to the code at the end of each row.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown in the empty field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error message; replaces the helper text and is set as the field's error.

options.name: clearOptionLabel
options.description: Adds a first row that clears the selection. Hidden while searching.

options.name: clearIcon
options.description: The icon of a clear button at the end of the field while something is chosen. Monarch bundles no icons; without it there is no clear button.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: the label "Currency", "Suggested", "All currencies", "No currencies match" and the combobox's own strings.

states.name: closed
states.description: The field shows the chosen currency's label, or the placeholder (or the floating label) while nothing is chosen.

states.name: open
states.description: The bottom sheet (or, for eight options or fewer, the menu) lists the options; while nothing is typed the suggested ones come first under their heading.

states.name: searching
states.description: Typing filters the list, best matches first, without headings; when nothing matches the list says so.

states.name: error
states.description: The field has the danger outline and the message below it, and the message is the field's error for TalkBack.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field takes the disabled colors and does not open.

appearance: The field is MonarchCombobox's: MonarchTextField's colors, a surface fill with the input border, the danger strong color in error; the sheet is on the surface color, second lines, hints and headings are muted text and the chosen row's radio mark is the accent strong color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Built on MonarchCombobox, so long lists open a Material 3 bottom sheet with a search field instead of the web's popover. The parity map named Currency.getAvailableCurrencies, but that list includes funds, precious metals, test codes and retired currencies, so the web component's list of active codes is bundled and java.util.Currency only names them; a code the runtime does not know (a new currency on an old Android version) shows its code as its name. Symbols are java.util.Currency.getSymbol in the locale ("$" in the US, "US$" elsewhere), not the web's narrow symbol. The value is controlled only. iOS has no CurrencySelect yet; the name is the planned shared one.
accessibility: The field is MonarchCombobox's Material 3 exposed dropdown anchor: TalkBack reads the label, the chosen value and the expand state; double tap opens the list.

Every row is read with its label, second line and hint, and the chosen row is selected with a filled radio mark, so the choice does not rely on color; in the sheet each row is a radio button at least 48dp high.
The headings over suggested and other entries are headings; the no-match message is a polite live region.
The error is the field's error semantics and is shown as text.
edgeCases: A selected code that is not in the list is still listed, so the field shows its name.
Searching matches every typed word in the name, the code, the symbol and, outside English, the English name: "$" finds the dollars.
A code unknown to the runtime is listed under its code.
Lower-case codes are accepted; onSelectedChange always reports upper case.

examples.title: Suggested currencies first
examples.template:
MonarchCurrencySelect(
    initiallyOpen = true,
    // Open as the web's popover under the field, not as a full-height sheet.
    presentation = MonarchComboboxPresentation.Menu,
    selected = currency,
    onSelectedChange = { currency = it },
    locale = Locale.forLanguageTag({{locale}}),
    priority = listOf({{priority.0}}, {{priority.1}}, {{priority.2}}),
    placeholder = {{placeholder}},
    helperText = {{helper}},
    labels = MonarchCurrencySelectLabels(label = {{label}}),
)
examples.code:
MonarchCurrencySelect(
    initiallyOpen = true,
    // Open as the web's popover under the field, not as a full-height sheet.
    presentation = MonarchComboboxPresentation.Menu,
    selected = currency,
    onSelectedChange = { currency = it },
    locale = Locale.forLanguageTag("en"),
    priority = listOf("EUR", "GBP", "USD"),
    placeholder = "Search name, code or symbol",
    helperText = "Totals convert to EUR.",
    labels = MonarchCurrencySelectLabels(label = "Reporting currency"),
)

examples.title: The provider's currencies by code and name
examples.code:
MonarchCurrencySelect(
    selected = payout,
    onSelectedChange = { payout = it },
    currencies = listOf("USD", "EUR", "GBP"),
    display = MonarchCurrencySelectDisplay.CodeAndName,
)
